messages:
elaine_cs: FYI posting private/VPC health check for Orchid Health (week ending). Quick highlights below — full log pasted.
vikram_sre: thanks. can you call out the regions with actions needed?
elaine_cs: sure — summary: eu-west-1 had a connectivity flap Tue 11:15-11:40 (impact: short 95th latency spike); ap-southeast-1 experienced intermittent KMS timeouts Wed evening, auto-retries recovered; us-east-1 steady. No data-exfil or auth failures. KMS auto-rotation triggered one warning but completed.
marco_success: got it. is there an open ticket for the eu-west flap? customers asking for RCA.
elaine_cs: opened CS-4921 for Orchid; assigned to @vikram_sre. short RCA draft below.
vikram_sre: acknowledging. attaching relevant runtime logs:
```
2026-03-14T11:12:07Z eu-west-1 node-3: connection timeout to NLB -> retry
2026-03-14T11:17:39Z eu-west-1 node-2: recovered; failed requests ~ 1.2k (mainly short requests, median latency 48ms -> 420ms spike)
2026-03-14T11:40:12Z eu-west-1 cluster: rebalance completed
```
vikram_sre: preliminary cause looks like an autoscale / rolling update + unexpected NLB health-check delay. We'll correlate with infra deploy logs.
katie_eng: I saw a burst of autoscaler scale-down events around 11:05 then back up at 11:20. maybe pod churn + NLB health-check window.
elaine_cs: KMS detail from kms-bot below — one HSM rotation warning in ap-southeast-1, id hsm-07b9. rotation retried and succeeded at 23:18 UTC.
kms-bot: KMS ALERT: ap-southeast-1 hsm-07b9 rotation warning at 2026-03-11T22:49:03Z. Retry success at 2026-03-11T23:18:07Z. No key access denied events detected.
marco_success: Orchid noted spend bump in ap-southeast-1 during the retries — around +14% token spend due to retry duplication. flagged in CS-4921.
elaine_cs: action items: 1) @vikram_sre dig into autoscaler & deploy timing and produce RCA by EOD Thurs. 2) @katie_eng add a health-check tuning recommendation (reduce NLB health-check grace) and post to the private deployment runbook. 3) CS follow-up with Orchid: explain RCA and credit for duplicate tokens (estimate prepared by finance). 
vikram_sre: taking action 1. initial hypothesis: NLB health-check timeout config (10s) + pod termination grace (30s) => overlap. will test a staging config.
katie_eng: will propose config: health-check interval 5s, healthy threshold 2, unhealthy threshold 3; will simulate with canary today.
elaine_cs: customer-facing note prepared: "We observed a short connectivity disruption in eu-west-1 during a background rolling update which caused transient latency spikes. Our engineers have adjusted load-balancer/probe timing and validated recovery. We will apply these changes to the private clusters and credit duplicate requests caused by retries." will post to CS ticket after vetting.
marco_success: can we also add a proactive alert for KMS rotation warning? want to avoid customer-facing retries next time.
kms-bot: SUGGESTION: add alert rule kms.rotation_warning where severity = P2 and notify #eng-oncall + #customer-success.
elaine_cs: added that to the weekly action tracker. final note: uptime per region this week (customer-visible): eu-west-1 99.95% (downtime ~21m), ap-southeast-1 99.96 (KMS retries + brief spikes), us-east-1 99.999. I'll close the loop once RCA posted. :white_check_mark:
vikram_sre: will post RCA link in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
marco_success: thanks team. tagging finance for credit calc. @katie_eng add the runbook PR link here when ready.
elaine_cs: thanks — closing weekly thread.
